title: Stop apologizing for the power God placed inside you. 💥
paragraphs: Stop apologizing for the power God placed inside you. 💥

The enemy loves it when you play small, quiet, and contained. Why? Because a fully awakened, Spirit-filled warrior is terrifying to the kingdom of darkness. Your potential will always intimidate insecure people. That’s not your problem; it’s their revelation.
It’s time to break the box they tried to put you in and step into the fullness of your calling. No more shrinking back.
📖 "For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." – 2 Timothy 1:7
Are you ready to rise? ⚔️ Follow @iamGospelWarrior for daily battle marching orders.
